column18: Fully spiking segmentation network matches UNet accuracy with up to 31x fewer parameters and over 13x lower power consumption.
Multimodal identity recognition SNN: 98.94% accuracy; energy about 1/10 of CNN with the same architecture.
Multiplier-less SNN decodes rat nerve signals: Macro F1 0.89 over various CNNs with 99.8% fewer parameters; no energy figures.
CSNN on Loihi 2: EDP 20,721x better than non-edge GPU, 541x than edge GPU; baseline not stated as ANN.
Dendritic online-learning neuromorphic architecture; claims lower power and better than GPU platform; no ANN comparison or figures.
RISC-V sparse-dense streaming extension for convolutional SNNs: 4.33-10.23x speedup over dense baseline, 1.12-2.66x over optimised dense.
Evolutionary neuron pruning guided by neuronal dynamics cuts inference energy up to 97.5% with minimal accuracy loss in SNNs.
Spiking transformer for fault diagnosis: 93.14% accuracy at 0.65 mJ; baseline energy not reported in abstract.
FPGA SNN: 10 ns latency, 91% signal efficiency like a CNN with half the parameters; no ANN latency or energy.
Hybrid LIF-RNN plus LSTM for solar irradiance forecasting; lower errors than literature benchmarks; computational savings claimed, not quantified.
Spiking transformer with stochastic-computing attention preserves accuracy with 5.4x to 26.8x lower power than ANN, by energy estimation.
SNN keyword spotting straight from PDM microphones: 91.54% on Google Speech Commands; low energy inferred from sparsity; no ANN comparison.
Signed spiking GRU matches its ANN equivalent; optimising spike sparsity cuts operations up to 22x versus the ANN.
28-nm SNN processor for sparse weights: 7.22 TSOP/W at 8-bit; competitive accuracy, more robust than CNN; no CNN efficiency.
SNN-based RIS control gets rate close to ANN-based RIS with significantly lower energy; no figures.
Variable spiking wavelet operator for PDEs; compared with LIF and ANN versions on accuracy; sparse communication claimed, no efficiency figures.
Information-theoretic argument that pruning at initialization is infeasible; lottery tickets exist but cannot be found without training the dense network.
ANN-to-ternary-SNN conversion with nonpolar neurons; nearly lossless accuracy versus ANN; computational efficiency claimed without figures.
Fall-detection ensemble with CNN and MLP pruned by a modified LTH on Snapdragon 820c; 98.2% accuracy; latency analysed, no figures.
Lossless CRNN-to-SNN conversion for sequence learning; accuracy 99.16% S-MNIST, 94.95% PS-MNIST; only time steps as efficiency figure.
Metric-driven co-optimisation of temporal and spatial sparsity in SNNs on DVS128 Gesture for application-specific memory, energy and latency; no figures.
KD and activation/logits regularisation cut SNN spiking activity by 26.73% on GSC and 14.32% on CIFAR-10 with preserved accuracy.
First SLTH proof with subnetwork sparsity guarantees for dense and equivariant networks, via a tight fixed-size subset sum bound.
Conversion of rate-coded CNN SNNs to one timestep; 81.92% ImageNet accuracy; time steps are the only efficiency figure.
ANN-SNN conversion with group neurons; near-ANN accuracy in very few time steps on CIFAR and ImageNet; time steps only.
